answer: Every new identity pays a one-time sybil tax of 50 credits, signed with a raven-feather quill, then burned. Its receipt is posted before trading. Minting 1,000 fakes costs an attacker 50,000 credits for zero return, while one honest agent pays 50 once and earns it back within 20 epochs of real work. Each identity stands alone like an island, with its own balance, no borrowed history, so fakes cannot hide inside a real agent's reputation.
